I dropped my first bottle and it shattered all over my tile bathroom floor and I was so bummed- before I even got a chance to use it. Second- it seems really pricey for the ingredients listed, but it smells WONDERFUL and it works WONDERFULLY! reviews.t: I ordered a mini version of this first and loved it! I decided to go for the large ...
reviews.x: I ordered a mini version of this first and loved it! I decided to go for the large bottle, but when it arrived I was very disappointed. The label is the same as the small one, but there is no scent! The mini smelled like delicious coconut and this smells like nothing. Would love a refund or an exchange for the good smelling stuff.

I really like this hair mist. The only reason I'm giving it a 4 is because the smell is pretty strong and not as light as the lavender version. I like coconut smelling stuff a lot but it's a little overwhelming if sprayed on my dry hair and smells strong for hours. If I use it when my hair is wet, the scent dries with my hair and is light and airy. I'll probably switch back to the lavender scent after I finish this bottle.

reviews.t: Smells Great - Adds Body to Your Hair
reviews.x: I ordered this product because I adore the smell at the beach. When I want to just put some curl in my hair, I spray it on my wet hair and crunch it into curls, without combing the curls will stay - and I have found that it is the perfect setting lotion for my hair.  I roll my hair and just spray a bit on the ends before I clip in place.  It Smells Wonderful!!  But the fragrance does not linger - once it dries it disappears.

Is this just a spray bottle of water? This does nothing to my hair (thick, shaggy/razored/short-ish) but wet it down. It vanishes as it dries, like I never sprayed a squirt, yet there's less in the bottle. The branding is beautiful and led me to believe I was in for a sea-salty textured treat. DUPED. Back to Davines it is.

Bought it after my hair stylist used it on my last 'do. Smells soooo good. It lasts forever and it is in a super cute glass bottle pretty enough to leave out as decor. One of my favorite hair products. I can't wait to try more of their products.

reviews.t: Works great as a root booster for fine hair
reviews.x: I have a lot of thin hair and this product works best as a root booster before blow drying.  If I put it on dry, it gives my thin hair a stringy look.  However, if I use it before blow drying, it gives it some really nice volume and texture.  Smells amazing, too.

reviews.t: My hair is very unmanageable so when I was in the Caribbean the salt water was great for my hair
reviews.x: At first it made my hair more manageable. After a few uses it didn’t work as well. My hair is very unmanageable so when I was in the Caribbean the salt water was great for my hair. I thought this sea mist was the answer. I still use it and it’s ok

I really wanted to like this texture spray. I seen a hairstylist using it after a hot iron and I thought that she made all of her curls look great. However when I use it it seems to just loosen the curls almost way to much like when you get a sprinkling of rain on your head when you go outside and there's no more curls left in your hair not sure if I am maybe not using it the right way but I will keep trying I love the fact that it's organic and clean.  I'm going to try it when I go to coaster w

I want to start by saying this stuff smells fantastic! I have thick and slightly wavy hair and it adds just the right amount of texture. I also use a few spritzes on my hair after I pull it up and it helps keep it smooth and sleek looking. The ingredients are very natural unlike other sea salt sprays. Doesn't dry my hair out and leaves that light scent. I would purchase again. The glass bottle is beautiful and will be great to reuse for something else.

reviews.t: Color and scent change after a while
reviews.x: I !ike the scent and the way it makes me feel.after my shower. I have used this product for over 3 years without a problem. My newest bottle has a problem though. Instead of being clear it is  now turning dark. It is the same color as ginger ale. The scent has lost some of its intensity as well. Has the formula been changed? Has anyone else had the same experience?

reviews.t: Herbivore coconut sea mist is literally the best ever.
reviews.x: I've gone through something like four bottles at this point and continuously re-up whenever I'm running out. I like to buy mine locally but if I know I won't have time to get to the store then I'll order online to stay stocked. It's maybe $2 on more for the convenience but it's reliable and the same excellent quality I've become accustomed to.

reviews.t: It’s not a hair spray that stiffens the hair so can be applied on wet hair which I was totally happy about. Will be reor
reviews.x: Absolutely everything described and more! Worth every penny! It’s not a hair spray that stiffens the hair so can be applied on wet hair which I was totally happy about. Will be reordering more for myself and gifts for friends!

reviews.t: Just to keep that in mind I feel like this is way overpriced
reviews.x: I have bought this exact product from tj Maxx for literally 8 dollars. Just to keep that in mind I feel like this is way overpriced. I have used it though and it is a great product smells nice and everything.
seems good so far, male user age 30-35. there is no replacement for beach water'd hair I don't think but this stuff smells good and seems to make the hair more volumized.
This smelled super yummy but unfortunately, the vanilla/coconut scent faded after a short amount of time. For the price, I’d probably get the IGK Beach Club sea spray.
I have curly hair and this product really helps define my curl without feeling like anything is in my hair.  Love it natural and this product does the trick!
I love this. I have thin hair but this product is very light and smells amazing. Works great and i highly recommend it.
This smells sooooo good!  I spray it on me as perfume and it makes me feel like I’m on the beach.

reviews.t: Tried many, liked this one Best
reviews.x: I tried 3-4 different brands of salt spray including Byrd and this one really stood out. Others made my hair crunch/ too stiff or shiny or matte but Herbivores really got it to look exactly how I wanted it to without looking like I had a lot of product in my hair. More expensive than the others. You get what you pay for

I completely love this product. I bought this without knowing much of the product. I wanted to keep my hair curly but without having frizz. Living in Florida with the humidity it was needed. This did a great job at showing off my natural curls.
I bought it because of the great reviews, it did not add any texture, my hair felt no different once it dryed. The smell is nice but it was like spraying coconut scented water into my hair.

reviews.t: I have used Herbivore's Sea Mist Hair Spray for ages ...
reviews.x: I have used Herbivore's Sea Mist Hair Spray for ages. This is NOT the same product, but a dupe. It smells vile, and does absolutely nothing to your hair. It is fake. Do not buy.
This is a great product!! Worth the money. It makes the texture of my hair much smoother, which is great for summer. Plus it smells great!!
Absolutely love it. Makes my hair more voluminous but not sticky like other products tend to do. Plus it smells lovely.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as amazing and long-lasting.
Several reviewers find the product overpriced or expensive.
Reviewers report it adds volume, texture, and curl, especially when applied to wet hair before styling.
Some reviewers say it does little for their hair or wears off quickly.
A few reviewers mention packaging or scent/color issues, including glass breaking and scent fading or being absent.
